metadata.description: Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics workspace name

properties.displayName: PSOC - Suspicious usage of Cobalt Strike psexec command
properties.description:
Detects the use of cobalt strike.
The default service installation will be a random 7 character named service.
properties.query:
//Service Ticket #4360554  - Exclude legitimate VirtualBox service installations to reduce false positives
// Service Ticket #4625479 - Exclude legitimate Memurai for Gridbeyond
//Detects CobaltStrike service installation, the name will be 7 random characters, and the filename will be an IP followed by 7 chars.exe
DeviceEvents
| where ActionType == "ServiceInstalled"
| where AdditionalFields.ServiceName matches regex @"^[\w]{7}$"
| where FileName matches regex @"^[\w]{7}\.exe$"
| where not(FolderPath startswith "C:\\Program Files\\Oracle\\VirtualBox")
| where AdditionalFields.ServiceName <> "Memurai"
| extend
  Computer = tostring(column_ifexists("DeviceName", "")),
  Account = tostring(column_ifexists("AccountName", "")),
  ProcessId = tostring(column_ifexists("InitiatingProcessId", "")),
  CommandLineMapped = tostring(column_ifexists("InitiatingProcessCommandLine", ""))
